messages:
marco: Quick sanity check before we tag v1.8.0-rc1 — plan is annotated + GPG-signed tag, then GH draft release with artifacts and RELEASE_NOTES.md. Changelog PR is ready in #eng-releases (PR #1123). Any objections or missing steps?

release-bot: CI artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/ci-20250315-789/ (artifacts: redwood-server-1.8.0-rc1-linux.tar.gz, redwood-1.8.0rc1.whl). Link: https://releases.redwood.ai/v1.8.0/ (auto) :white_check_mark:

carla: small Q — I already bumped package.json to 1.8.0-rc1 in release branch (see PR #1123). Should we include the full changelog in the GH release body or link to the changelog file? I can generate RELEASE_NOTES.md if needed.

ben: Annotated + signed tag sounds right. Also remember to mark the GH release as a prerelease. I can handle the tag/push step once CI is green and the changelog commit lands. Please wait for my ping before tagging.

marco: Copy. Tagging command I'll run (example):

```bash
git checkout release/v1.8
git pull origin release/v1.8
git tag -a v1.8.0-rc1 -m "v1.8.0-rc1" -s
git push origin v1.8.0-rc1
# then create draft release with GH CLI
gh release create v1.8.0-rc1 ./artifacts/* --draft --prerelease --title "v1.8.0-rc1" --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES.md
```

emma: Confirming artifact names include build id. CI will generate: redwood-server-1.8.0-rc1-linux.tar.gz, redwood-server-1.8.0-rc1-darwin.tar.gz, redwood-1.8.0rc1-py3-none-any.whl. Also will drop detached signatures (.asc) next to each file.

ops-bot: Heads up: release pipeline will NOT auto-promote rc artifacts to staging. Manual promote label required.

carla: I'll push RELEASE_NOTES.md into the release branch in ~25m (including highlights from changelog generator). @ben — can you hold on tagging until that commit is merged?

ben: Yep, hold for my green. Please ping me in thread once pushed. :thumbsup:

marco: Thanks — cutoff reminder: 18:00 PT today for this rc. If the changelog commit misses that window we'll move to rc2 next week. :alarm_clock:

carla: noted. I'll prioritize the changelog.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: 17:30 PT - prepare for tagging.

ben: If anything blocks signing/key access, ping security. I can also sign locally if needed.

marco: Perfect. I'll watch for the ping and do the GH release creation after you confirm. Thanks all. :rocket:
